item.title: Retraction Notice
item.description: The article entitled “Heritage management of temple tanks in an urban scenario - a case study of Thirupporur, a traditional town in the state of Tamilnadu, India” https://doi.org/10.6092/issn.1973-9494/4188, published online and in the print version of our Journal, N.13 - 2013, has been retracted due to evidence of extensive plagiarism. The retraction is issued by the Editor-in-Chief, Salvatore Lorusso, in compliance with the Journal’s Code of Conduct and following the workflow proposed by COPE.

item.title: Erratum
item.description: Weathering of Outdoor Beech Wood and Methods of Conservation Due to an editorial error on the article Ali, M. (2020). Weathering of Outdoor Beech Wood and Methods of Conservation issued on the vol 20 (https://doi.org/10.6092/issn.1973-9494/12797), the figures n.4 and n.5 on page 170 were omitted. The article has been amended on 2021-05-27 showing the appropriate figures. We do apologize with readers and the author for this oversight.
